title: Three Nights and One Short Shutter
subtitle: 风暴防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 风暴防范（人与自然·灾害防范·风暴与极端天气）
meta: 主题语境：风暴防范（人与自然·灾害防范·风暴与极端天气）　|　核心词汇：hurricane　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hurricane 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the captain ① tracked the hurricane that no fisherman in the coast would have described, and he said the tracking was the whole of the September. The ② hurricane, meaning the storm itself and not the shutter, ran three Septembers and stayed undescribed in the book; a hurricane, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hurricane in that coast had the same short shutter beside it, and the ④ hurricane at the far harbour, meaning the shelter they kept for the children to reach and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hurricane, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the captain said the describing is the part that fills three Septembers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hurricane was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the storm. The ⑥ hurricane, meaning the warning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hurricane, he said, is either something you track or the only word that means both a storm and a warning. He said the warning is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ hurricane had become a line in a bulletin, and the bulletin had become an argument about the short shutter. The ⑧ hurricane of the whole thing, the captain wrote in August, was one coast and three Septembers of describing; hurricane, he said, is either the shelter at the far harbour or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hurricane I remember is the storm described in the bulletin, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ hurricane, my mother said in 1988, is the only storm that improves by being described; every hurricane, she said, is a warning that has agreed to look like a storm. She said the warning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 飓风；风暴（指海岸里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 飓风；风暴（指那场风暴本身，与挡板相对）
C. 固定搭配：track the hurricane 追踪这场飓风
D. n. 飓风；风暴（指留给孩子们跑去的那一处那一场）
E. n. 风灾之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的飓风之事）
F. n. 飓风；风暴（指公告里写到、被记下的的那一场）
G. n. 警报、警示（指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 警示（抽象总称，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tracked the hurricane that no fisherman in the coast would have described
The hurricane, meaning the storm itself and not the shutter
the hurricane at the far harbour
the hurricane was the whole of the matter
the hurricane had become a line in a bulletin
The hurricane of the whole thing
A hurricane, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: track the hurricane 意为“追踪这场飓风”，1979 年那位船长把海岸里没有一位渔民肯描述的一场飓风做了一遍。
hurricane 意为“飓风；风暴”，指那场风暴本身而不是挡板，它经过了三个九月而在簿子上没有被描述。
hurricane 意为“飓风；风暴”，指海岸里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块薄薄的挡板。
hurricane 意为“飓风；风暴”，指最远那座港湾留给孩子们跑去的那一处那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hurricane 意为“警报、警示”，指一件事里人人都防却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道警报就是那件事的全部。
hurricane 意为“警示”，指人人都防却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场风暴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hurricane 意为“飓风；风暴”，指公告里写到、被记下的的那一场，到 1984 年这一场成了公告里的一行。
hurricane 意为“风灾之事”，船长八月写道，整件事的飓风之事是一处海岸和三个九月的描述。
hurricane 意为“飓风；风暴”，我记得的是公告里描述过的那一场，1986 年过去了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一场。
hurricane 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，飓风是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的风暴。
